title: Head Marketing And Operations
description:
Job Purpose To lead, plan, and manage all Marketing Operations activities across regions, including outdoor branding, BTL promotions, exhibitions, in-site branding, vendor management, project launches, cross-functional coordination, audit controls, budgeting, and process improvement. The Head ensures seamless execution of all marketing operations that enhance brand presence, improve customer engagement, and support sales conversion. Key Responsibilities 1. Leadership & Strategy Lead the Marketing Operations Team, including TLs, MIS executives, coordinators, and field operations staff. Define roles, responsibilities, workflows, and performance standards. Plan & execute annual and quarterly operations calendars: BTL campaigns Outdoor branding Exhibitions Sponsorship activities Project branding Launch events Develop cost-efficient strategies for branding & vendor engagement. Work closely with: Branding & Creative Digital Marketing Sales CRM Project Teams Ensure alignment with organizational objectives. 2. Continuous Improvement Review gaps in operations and implement improved processes. Drive innovation in branding & outdoor execution. Optimize vendor rates, material usage, and execution speed. 3. Outdoor & BTL Operations Management Oversee all outdoor activities including hoardings, banners, kiosks, van campaigns, roadshows, exhibitions, & sponsorships. Ensure adherence to brand guidelines across all touchpoints. Lead the planning & execution of: Project launches Trade fairs Mall activations Partner events Ensure smooth logistical coordination and strong brand presence. 4. Vendor Management & Procurement Identify and onboard vendors for: Printing Fabrication Events & Exhibitions Outdoor branding Conduct negotiations for pricing & service agreements. Establish standards for material quality, installation accuracy, and turnaround time. Conduct periodic vendor audits and performance reviews. 5. Process, Audit & Budget Controls Manage departmental budgets including: Outdoor expenses Vendor payments Launch & event spending Collaterals Track expenses against budgets and ensure cost optimization. Implement audit processes for: Vendor invoices Branding material usage Event expenditure Site branding Ensure compliance with organizational procurement policies. 6. Team Development & Performance Management Train teams on: Outdoor execution Vendor coordination Cost control Branding guidelines Field operations Mentor TLs and develop strong leadership pipeline. Conduct reviews, provide feedback, and track KPIs for all team members. 7. Reporting & MIS Governance Ensure timely reporting of: Vendor expenses Site branding status Event performance reports Outdoor campaign tracking Audit reports Review and validate MIS submitted by coordinators and MIS executives.

title: Marketing and Operations Manager
description:
Job Purpose To lead the marketing operations team and oversee all on-ground and administrative activities including outdoor branding, vendor management, audit control, project launches, event support, collaterals management, expense tracking, and reporting. The TL ensures operational excellence, cost efficiency, and timely execution of all marketing requirements across projects and regions. Key Responsibilities 1. Team Management Assign tasks to coordinators, MIS executives, and outdoor operations staff. Set priorities and ensure all deadlines are met. Review team progress, productivity, and task completion. Provide training and guidance to improve role effectiveness. Coordinate between field staff and central office teams for daily outdoor activities. 2. Vendor Management Work with vendors for printing, fabrication, installation, branding materials, event setup, exhibitions, and more. Share detailed requirements and supervise execution. Ensure vendor billing aligns with approved rates. Verify quality and accuracy of delivered branding materials. Track vendor timelines, reliability, and output quality. Recommend vendor retention or replacement based on performance. 3. Project Launch Execution Collaborate with sales, branding, and projects team for launch readiness. Oversee branding deployment, signage installation, and vendor coordination. Ensure smooth execution from setup to event completion. 4. Audit & Compliance Validate invoices for: Correct rates Quantities Authorized expenses Supporting documents Approve invoices for finance processing. Conduct random field audits to ensure: Branding is installed correctly Materials match reported usage Outdoor activities are executed as documented 5. Expense Management Track daily, weekly, and monthly expenses for: Outdoor branding Exhibitions Printing Launch operations Ensure expenses are within approved budgets. Identify areas to reduce operational costs without compromising quality. 6. Site Operations Oversight Supervise activities such as: Banner installations Flex boards Hoardings Roadshows Event setups Ensure branding consistency across all locations. Plan & execute branding, logistics, and setup activities for project launch events. 7. Collaterals & Inventory Management Track availability of brochures, standees, flyers, signage, and display materials. Ensure collaterals reach relevant teams and project sites on time. 8. Reporting & MIS Oversight Review daily reports on: Branding installations Vendor activities Operational updates Validate MIS accuracy on indents, POs, expenses, and outdoor operations.

title: Marketing and Operations Executive
description:
Job Purpose To execute and manage all BTL and outdoor marketing activities, including exhibitions, sponsorships, in-site branding, vendor coordination, collaterals deployment, and project launch activities. This role ensures timely execution of all on-ground promotional initiatives to increase customer footfall, project visibility, and brand presence. Key Responsibilities 1. BTL & Outdoor Marketing Execution Execute outdoor branding activities including: Flex boards Banners Hoardings Auto/van branding Roadshows Bus shelters Ensure brand guidelines are followed at all locations. Coordinate and execute real estate exhibitions, mall activations, kiosks, and outdoor events. Manage stall fabrication, branding, visitor flows, and promotional activities. Identify potential sponsorship opportunities. Liaise with event hosts or associations for branding presence. Execute branding materials at sponsorship sites. 2. Vendor Management Identify and coordinate with vendors for printing, fabrication, events, and installations. Negotiate and compare vendor pricing for cost efficiency. Inspect delivered materials for brand accuracy and quality. Ensure timely delivery and installation. 3. Project Launches & Promotions Assist in organizing project launch events. Coordinate branding, seating, lighting, stage setup, and refreshments. Support on-ground marketing campaigns to drive customer visits. Deploy promotional materials across designated locations. 4. In-Site Branding & Promotions Install and maintain branding materials at: Project entrances Sales cabins Internal roads Common areas Ensure all elements (direction boards, banners, welcome boards) are updated. Work with project managers for site readiness. Ensure timely setup before customer visits or launch events. 5. Reporting & Documentation Maintain trackers for: Branding deployment Vendor approvals Outdoor activities Expense utilization Submit daily/weekly reports to the TL. Maintain an archive of branding photos, vendor invoices, and material usage reports.
